meta.title: Crown of Embers
meta.tagline: The old fire died. You are the spark that remains.
meta.description: A single-player dark fantasy action RPG set on the Shattered Continent — a land broken when the Ember Crown, a relic of divine flame, was sundered into seven shards and scattered across the world. Each shard corrupted the land around it, twisting nature and mortals into monstrous forms. You are an Emberborn — a soul marked by the Crown's dying light, able to wield elemental magic through ancient Runes found in the world. Journey through five vast, hostile regions to reclaim the shards, confront the Wardens who guard them, and decide whether to restore the Crown's fire or let the world burn and be reborn. No classes — your abilities are defined by which Runes you attune and how you combine them. A swordmaster can become a storm mage by swapping runes at a bonfire. The world rewards exploration, preparation, and mastery of its deep combat system.

mounts_vehicles.name: Ashbound Stag
mounts_vehicles.description: A pale white elk with ember-lit antlers. Found in the Pale Reach. Can leap across small chasms.

mounts_vehicles.name: Ravenscourge Hawk
mounts_vehicles.description: A massive black raven tamed at the Sky Perch. Glides from elevated points. Cannot truly fly.

mounts_vehicles.name: Ironclad Boar
mounts_vehicles.description: A war boar armored in natural iron plates. Charges through enemies. Found in the Sunken Forge.

weapon_categories.name: Greatswords
weapon_categories.description: Two-handed blades of devastating reach. Wide arcs cleave multiple foes. Heavy commitment on each swing.

weapon_categories.name: Straight Swords
weapon_categories.description: Balanced one-handed blades. Fast thrusts and slashes. Pair with a shield or off-hand rune.

weapon_categories.name: Twinblades
weapon_categories.description: Double-ended spinning weapons. Relentless combos but low stagger. Bleed buildup on sustained hits.

weapon_categories.name: Warhammers
weapon_categories.description: Massive striking weapons. Shatter armor, stagger giants. Devastating charged attacks.

weapon_categories.name: Spears
weapon_categories.description: Long-reaching thrust weapons. Control distance. Excellent against charging enemies.

weapon_categories.name: Longbows
weapon_categories.description: Precision ranged weapons. Charged shots pierce armor. Craft specialized arrows for elemental effects.

weapon_categories.name: Shortbows
weapon_categories.description: Quick-fire bows for mobile combat. Lower damage but rapid shots. Excellent for applying status arrows.

weapon_categories.name: Catalysts
weapon_categories.description: Runic staves and orbs that channel elemental magic. Damage type changes with equipped Rune.

weapon_categories.name: Chime Shields
weapon_categories.description: Enchanted shields that can block and cast. Parry timing triggers a holy burst that staggers attackers.

status_effects.name: Burning
status_effects.effect: Fire damage over 6 seconds. Spreads to nearby enemies if they stand in oil. Stacks to 3.

status_effects.name: Frostbitten
status_effects.effect: Slows movement by 25%. At 3 stacks, freezes target solid for 2 seconds. Broken by any hit.

status_effects.name: Shocked
status_effects.effect: Crackling energy. Next hit chains lightning to 2 nearby enemies. Standing in water while shocked deals bonus damage.

status_effects.name: Bleeding
status_effects.effect: Physical damage over time. Damage increases as health decreases. Stacks with successive hits.

status_effects.name: Withered
status_effects.effect: Reduces max health by 15% until rested at a bonfire. Healing effectiveness halved.

status_effects.name: Consecrated
status_effects.effect: Undead and shadow enemies take continuous holy damage. Allies in range regenerate slowly.

status_effects.name: Hollowing
status_effects.effect: Each death increases Hollowing. Higher Hollowing reduces max HP but increases rune find and dark damage.

status_effects.name: Stagger
status_effects.effect: Interrupts current action. Build-up based on poise damage taken. Heavy weapons build faster.

status_effects.name: Parried
status_effects.effect: Riposte window opened. Target is completely vulnerable for a devastating critical hit.

skill_trees.name: Way of the Blade
skill_trees.description: Master melee combat. Unlock combo chains, parry techniques, weapon arts, and charged attacks for each weapon type.

skill_trees.name: Way of the Arrow
skill_trees.description: Master ranged combat. Unlock arrow types, aimed shots, rapid fire, and trap placement.

skill_trees.name: Way of the Rune
skill_trees.description: Deepen elemental attunement. Unlock more powerful spells, rune combos, and passive elemental effects.

skill_trees.name: Way of the Survivor
skill_trees.description: Improve health, stamina, equip load, poison resistance, and healing flask potency.

skill_trees.name: Way of the Wanderer
skill_trees.description: Enhance exploration. Faster sprint, reduced fall damage, hidden path detection, and mount bonuses.

currencies.name: Ember
currencies.description: The souls of the fallen, condensed into flickering flame. Dropped by all enemies. Lost on death. Can be recovered at your bloodstain.

currencies.name: Remnants
currencies.description: Crystallized memories of ancient heroes. Found in hidden tombs. Used for legendary weapon upgrades and unique spells.

currencies.name: Covenant Marks
currencies.description: Earned by completing tasks for the world's covenants. Trade for covenant-unique gear and spells.

custom_mechanics.name: Rune Attunement
custom_mechanics.description: Players equip Runes at bonfires that define their abilities. Each Rune channels one element and provides a set of weapon arts and spells. Equipping multiple runes of the same element unlocks Deep Attunement — a devastating ultimate ability.
rules: Players equip up to 3 active Runes and 1 passive Rune at bonfires.
Each Rune belongs to one of 6 elements: Fire, Frost, Storm, Holy, Shadow, Blood.
Deep Attunement (2+ same element): Unlocks an ultimate skill for that element.
Hybrid Attunement (mixed): Access to Rune Resonance combos but no ultimate.
Runes have tiers: Faded, Writ, Etched, Pristine. Higher tiers unlock more abilities.
Runes can be upgraded at the Runecrafting table using Rune Fragments.
interactions: Swapping runes at bonfires is free but resets your respawn point.
Some dungeon puzzles require specific elemental runes to open sealed doors.
Boss Warden phases are weak to specific elements — preparation is rewarded.
Hollowing level affects which runes you can equip — high Hollowing unlocks dark runes but locks holy ones.

custom_mechanics.name: Elemental Resonance
custom_mechanics.description: When two or more elements overlap on a target or terrain, they create a Resonance — a powerful emergent effect that rewards experimentation.
rules: Fire + Frost = Steam Cloud: 4m fog zone that blinds enemies and breaks lock-on.
Storm + Water (rain/puddles) = Electrified Ground: Standing enemies are stunned.
Fire + Oil (environmental) = Inferno: Massive fire AoE that persists.
Holy + Shadow = Annihilation: Burst of void damage that ignores all defenses.
Blood + Fire = Cauterize: Stops bleeding and heals a small amount.
Storm + Frost = Thunderfrost: Lightning strikes freeze targets on impact.
interactions: Weather affects resonance: rain enables Storm+Water combos naturally.
Some bosses create elemental terrain that enables or prevents certain reactions.
Environmental traps can be triggered by matching elements (fire arrow + oil trap).
The final boss fight requires mastering all resonance combos.

custom_mechanics.name: Ember and Death
custom_mechanics.description: A risk-reward death system inspired by soulslike design. Death costs you your Ember (currency) and increases Hollowing, but teaches you enemy patterns.
rules: On death, drop all Ember at your bloodstain. Reach it to recover, or lose it forever on second death.
Hollowing increases by 1 per death. At thresholds (10, 25, 50), your appearance changes and max HP decreases.
Higher Hollowing grants bonuses: increased Rune find chance, access to Shadow runes, NPC dialogue changes.
Bonfires restore health, refill flasks, reset enemies (except bosses), and serve as fast travel points.
Using a Humanity item at a bonfire reduces Hollowing by 5 and restores your human appearance.
interactions: Some NPCs only appear at certain Hollowing levels.
Covenant of the Hollow rewards players who maintain high Hollowing.
Speedrunners may intentionally Hollow for the damage bonuses.
The world visually changes at high Hollowing — more shadows, different enemy spawns.

environments.name: The Ember Vale
environments.visual_description: A vast valley of blackened earth and dying ember-grass, where the ground glows faintly orange beneath cracked soil. The skeleton of an ancient cathedral rises from the ash, its spire cracked and weeping embers like slow tears. Twisted trees with coal-black bark stand like sentinels, their leaves replaced by flickering ember motes that drift upward like inverted rain. Color palette: deep amber, charcoal black, burnt orange, ash grey, dying gold.
environments.audio_mood: Distant crackling of dying fires, wind whistling through hollow ruins, low groan of settling earth, footsteps crunching on ash-covered ground.

sub_areas.name: Ashfield Crossing
sub_areas.description: The starting area. Ruined crossroads with the first bonfire. Tutorial enemies.

sub_areas.name: The Hollow Cathedral
sub_areas.description: Massive ruined cathedral. First Rune altar and mini-boss: the Ember Priest.

sub_areas.name: Ember Graveyard
sub_areas.description: Undead soldiers rise from ashen graves. Hidden catacombs beneath a mausoleum.

sub_areas.name: The Scorched Bridge
sub_areas.description: Stone bridge over a chasm of molten earth. A dragon skeleton wedged in the arches. First Warden.

ambiance.lighting: Perpetual amber twilight. Ground glows faintly orange. Bonfires cast warm pools.
ambiance.fog: Thin ash haze. Thicker near ruins.
ambiance.particles: Floating ember motes, ash snowfall, sparks from bonfires.
ambiance.sky: Bruised amber to grey. No visible sun. Blood moon at night.

environments.name: The Frostbound Peaks
environments.visual_description: Towering mountains encased in ancient ice that never melts. Frozen waterfalls hang like glass curtains. Wind carves ice into impossible shapes — arches, spires, chambers that sing. At the summit, a fortress of crystallized ice glints like a diamond. Frozen soldiers stand mid-stride, caught in an ancient flash-freeze. Color palette: ice white, pale steel blue, silver, deep navy, glacial turquoise.
environments.audio_mood: Howling wind through ice, resonant hum of singing ice, cracking glaciers, distant avalanche rumbles.

sub_areas.name: The Frozen Approach
sub_areas.description: Winding paths with ice wolves and frost trolls.

sub_areas.name: Ice Spires Gallery
sub_areas.description: Cathedral of natural ice pillars. Prismatic light. Fire rune puzzles.

sub_areas.name: The Frozen Fortress
sub_areas.description: Citadel of living ice. Walls reform. Frostbound Warden and Frost Rune altar.

sub_areas.name: Dragon's Rest
sub_areas.description: Frozen dragon corpse, miles long, embedded in glacier. Hidden dungeon in its ribcage.

ambiance.lighting: Cold blue-white daylight. Prismatic ice refraction. Aurora at night.
ambiance.fog: Blinding blizzards randomly. Clear at peaks.
ambiance.particles: Snow flurries, ice crystals, frozen breath, glittering ice dust.
ambiance.sky: Pale steel blue at day, deep navy at night with aurora.

environments.name: The Sunken Forge
environments.visual_description: Colossal underground dwarven city built into a volcanic caldera, now flooded and half-collapsed. Massive iron chains span the cavern over still dark water. Forges are cold but scarred the stone — everything blackened, warped, fused with metal. Ancient dwarven automatons patrol on rusted legs, eyes glowing dim amber. Deeper levels descend to magma chambers where original forges still burn. Color palette: iron black, rust orange, copper green, dark grey, ember red.
environments.audio_mood: Constant dripping water, groaning metal, clanking automatons, hissing steam, deep volcanic rumble.

sub_areas.name: The Drowned Quarter
sub_areas.description: Upper city flooded to waist. Drowned ghosts. Swimming sections.

sub_areas.name: The Gearworks
sub_areas.description: Spinning gears, crushing pistons, conveyor belts. Platforming challenges.

sub_areas.name: The Magma Heart
sub_areas.description: Deepest forges still burning. Forge Warden — fire elemental in dwarven steel. Fire Rune altar.

sub_areas.name: The Armory Vault
sub_areas.description: Sealed vault with legendary weapons. Best smithing station.

ambiance.lighting: Dim amber from heat. Lava glow at depth. Automaton eyes as moving lights.
ambiance.fog: Steam in lower levels. Water mist above. Near-zero visibility in steam tunnels.
ambiance.particles: Falling water, steam plumes, sparks, floating rust.
ambiance.sky: No sky. Cavern ceiling with stalactites.

environments.name: The Verdant Tomb
environments.visual_description: An ancient forest that consumed an entire civilization. Massive temples split apart by building-sized tree roots. Canopy so thick the floor exists in permanent twilight, lit by bioluminescent fungi and corrupted nature spirits. Trees shift when you're not looking. Giant insects patrol the canopy. Deeper in, corruption shows: twisted pulsing roots, screaming flowers, animals with too many eyes. Color palette: deep emerald, bioluminescent cyan, stone grey, corruption purple, shadow black.
environments.audio_mood: Layered insect chorus, distant animal calls, creaking massive trees, bubbling streams, unsettling whispers of leaves.

sub_areas.name: The Outer Canopy
sub_areas.description: Forest edge. Giant trees, rope bridges. Druid NPCs. Relatively safe.

sub_areas.name: The Temple District
sub_areas.description: Ruined temples overtaken by nature. Each is a puzzle dungeon. Ancient murals tell history.

sub_areas.name: The Corruption Heart
sub_areas.description: Center of corruption. Trees walk. Air is toxic. Nature Warden guards Shadow Rune altar.

sub_areas.name: The Root Depths
sub_areas.description: Underground beneath roots. Bioluminescent fungi. Ancient burial chambers.

ambiance.lighting: Perpetual twilight. Bioluminescent glow. Occasional green-tinted sunlight.
ambiance.fog: Ground fog. Pollen haze. Toxic purple fog in corrupted zones.
ambiance.particles: Pollen, falling leaves, bioluminescent spores, firefly swarms.

environments.name: The Pale Reach
environments.visual_description: A vast featureless white plain stretching to infinity. No horizon — ground and sky merge into white void. Impossible geometries: looping staircases, doors opening onto the same room, towers taller inside than outside. Time and space are unreliable. Remnant Monoliths — massive black stones humming with void energy — contain memories of the world before the Sundering. At the center, the Ember Crown sits on a throne of nothing. Color palette: bone white, void black, ghost grey, impossible color flashes.
environments.audio_mood: Oppressive silence broken by distant echoes of ancient battles, monolith hum, your heartbeat, whispers that might be wind or voices.

sub_areas.name: The Threshold
sub_areas.description: Entry point. First impossible geometry — a bridge that exists only when not looked at.

sub_areas.name: Memory Halls
sub_areas.description: Dungeons inside Monoliths. Fully realized scenes from the past you can walk through.

sub_areas.name: The Impossible City
sub_areas.description: Looping architecture. Final merchants trade in memories instead of Ember.

sub_areas.name: The Throne of Nothing
sub_areas.description: Center of everything. The Ember Crown on its throne. Final Warden — Vorthak the Unraveled.

ambiance.lighting: Diffused white light, no source. Shadows point in impossible directions.
ambiance.fog: White void limiting visibility to 50m. Clears near Monoliths.
ambiance.particles: Static-like particles, ghost afterimages, reality distortion ripples.
ambiance.sky: No sky — white void above merges with ground.

dungeons.name: The Hollow Cathedral
dungeons.visual_description: A ruined cathedral of blackened stone. Pews overturned, altar cracked, stained glass shattered into colored shards on the floor. The deeper crypts are a maze of burial chambers where the dead have risen. The air smells of old incense and ash.

boss_encounters.name: The Ember Priest
boss_encounters.description: A hollowed cleric still performing last rites to a dead god. Throws fireballs and summons ember ghosts.
mechanics: Throws fireballs in 3-round bursts
Summons 2 ember ghosts every 30 seconds
Channel heal — must be interrupted with damage
At 50% enrages, fire attacks leave burning ground

puzzles: Reorder shattered stained glass to reveal hidden passage
Light 4 altar candles in correct elemental order

dungeons.name: The Frozen Fortress
dungeons.visual_description: A citadel of living ice where walls reform when damaged. Every surface is mirror-smooth ice. Enemies are visible through the walls — distorted, ghostly shapes moving through frozen corridors. The central chamber is a vast frozen lake with the Warden standing on the surface.

boss_encounters.name: The Frostbound Warden
boss_encounters.description: A knight encased in eternal ice. Moves with surprising speed. Creates ice clones of the player.
mechanics: Ice slide — dashes across the frozen floor leaving frost trails
Creates 2 ice clones that mirror player attacks
Breath attack creates expanding frost zone
At 30% the floor shatters — fight in water with ice platforms

traps: Ice spike floor traps triggered by weight
puzzles: Melt ice walls with fire runes in sequence
Reflect light beams off ice surfaces to open gates

dungeons.name: The Magma Heart
dungeons.visual_description: The deepest dwarven forges, still burning. Rivers of lava flow through carved channels. The heat distorts the air. Massive hammers still swing automatically, powered by geothermal pressure. The arena is a circular platform over a lava lake.

boss_encounters.name: The Forge Warden
boss_encounters.description: A fire elemental bound in dwarven mechanical armor. A walking forge. Its attacks create lava geysers.
mechanics: Hammer slam creates expanding lava fissures
Summons fire automatons from the forge walls
Forge phase — becomes invulnerable, must destroy the anvil
At 25% the arena floods — fight on shrinking platforms over lava
Vulnerable to frost — frost runes deal 3x damage

puzzles: Reroute lava flows to cool pathways
Cool heated doors with frost runes

dungeons.name: The Corruption Heart
dungeons.visual_description: The center of the Verdant Tomb where the Ember Shard has twisted all life. Trees walk. Flowers scream when touched. The ground is a pulsing network of dark roots. The air is thick purple fog that damages you over time. The arena is the hollowed trunk of the world's largest tree.

boss_encounters.name: The Nature Warden
boss_encounters.description: A colossal tree spirit — part ancient guardian, part corrupted horror. Its body is wood and shadow, with a face of screaming faces of those it consumed.
mechanics: Root slam — roots erupt from ground in patterns
Spore cloud — toxic fog that persists, must find clean air pockets
Tree shift — the arena changes shape, closing/opening paths
Consumes adds to heal — must kill minions before it reaches them
At 20% merges with the corruption — entire arena becomes hostile

traps: Root snares that hold you in place
puzzles: Purify corruption nodes in sequence while being attacked
Guide light through the canopy to weaken the Warden

dungeons.name: The Throne of Nothing
dungeons.visual_description: The center of the Pale Reach. A throne of absolute nothingness — a hole in reality shaped like a seat. The Ember Crown floats above it, radiating impossible colors. The arena has no floor — you stand on nothing. The rules of physics break down: gravity shifts, time loops, space folds. The final Warden exists partially outside reality.

boss_encounters.name: Vorthak the Unraveled
boss_encounters.description: The final Warden. A being that exists in multiple states simultaneously. Part man, part void, part memory of what the world was before.
mechanics: Reality phases — alternates between material and void plane every 60s
Unraveling — randomly deletes one ability for 20 seconds
Memory erasure — UI disappears for 10 seconds, rely on audio cues
Gravity inversion every 45 seconds
At 10% all phases combine — chaotic final stand
Defeating Vorthak gives the player a choice: restore the Crown or destroy it

traps: Reality tears teleporting to danger zones
Time loops that repeat the last 5 seconds
puzzles: Navigate non-euclidean corridors using Monolith compass
Phase between material and void to cross gaps

procedural_generation.description: Chalice Dungeons — procedurally generated underground labyrinths accessible from any bonfire. Randomized layouts, enemy placement, and elemental affixes. Deeper floors have better loot but harder enemies. Seeded runs for sharing.

player.visual_description: A weathered adventurer clad in scavenged armor. Face bears the marks of Hollowing — veins of dark energy that pulse when near death. Equipment visually changes appearance. Equipped Runes glow faintly on gauntlets and weapon.

abilities.name: Ember Strike
abilities.description: Basic melee attack. Damage type matches equipped weapon.

abilities.name: Rune Art
abilities.description: Weapon art powered by equipped Rune. Unique per rune element.

abilities.name: Flask of Healing
abilities.description: Drink from your flask to restore health. Refilled at bonfires.

abilities.name: Parry
abilities.description: If timed correctly, opens a riposte window. Shield or weapon dependent.

enemies.name: Ashen Hollow
enemies.description: Hollowed humans shambling through the Ember Vale. Slow but attack in groups.

enemies.name: Frost Wolf
enemies.description: Massive white wolves with ice-crusted fur. Fast and coordinated. Hunt in packs of 3-5.

enemies.name: Dwarven Automaton
enemies.description: Rusted mechanical dwarves still following ancient patrol routes. Strong but predictable patterns.

enemies.name: Corrupted Treant
enemies.description: Once-ancient guardian trees twisted by shadow corruption. Massive, slow, devastating.

enemies.name: Void Wraith
enemies.description: A ghost that phases between reality and void. Appears and disappears unpredictably.

enemies.name: The Ember Priest
enemies.description: A hollowed cleric still performing last rites. Throws fireballs and summons ember ghosts.

enemies.name: The Frostbound Warden
enemies.description: A knight encased in eternal ice. Creates ice clones of the player. Devastating frost combos.

enemies.name: Vorthak the Unraveled
enemies.description: The final Warden. Exists in multiple states simultaneously. Part man, part void, part memory.

categories.name: Weapons
categories.description: All weapon types from greatswords to catalysts.

categories.name: Runes
categories.description: Elemental runes that define your abilities.

enchanting_system.description: Infuse weapons with elemental properties at the Runecrafting table. Infusions add visual effects and scale with your Rune Attunement. Higher tiers risk destroying the weapon.

models_3d.name: The Ember Crown
models_3d.description: A broken crown of dark metal with seven empty sockets. Faint ember glow from within. Cracked and ancient, radiating divine heat.

models_3d.name: Dwarven Automaton
models_3d.description: A humanoid mechanical figure of riveted iron plates, standing 8 feet tall. Rust covers most surfaces. Eyes glow dim amber. Joints steam when moving.

models_3d.name: Frozen Dragon Corpse
models_3d.description: A dragon skeleton miles long, encased in glacial ice. Visible through the translucent ice — bones, teeth, and a still-beating heart glowing faintly.

models_3d.name: Monolith
models_3d.description: A 30-foot black stone obelisk inscribed with impossible geometries. Surface seems to absorb light. Void energy crackles along its edges.

textures.name: Ashen Iron
textures.description: Blackened iron with orange-red ember cracks visible through the surface. Heat-distortion effect at edges.

textures.name: Frostbitten Steel
textures.description: Silver metal with frost crystal formations growing from it. Pale blue-white with condensation frost.

textures.name: Living Wood
textures.description: Bark texture with visible veins of green energy pulsing beneath. Slightly moves/breathes.

textures.name: Void Corruption
textures.description: Healthy material breaking down into static-like void energy. Reality distortion at edges.

animations.name: Ember Strike
animations.description: Weapon swings with ember trail. Impact creates sparks. Follow-through has slight screen shake.

animations.name: Rune Activation
animations.description: Hands glow with elemental color. Rune symbols orbit wrists. Energy builds then releases.

animations.name: Parry Riposte
animations.description: Shield deflects with spark burst. Time slows for 0.5s. Counter-thrust with critical glow.

animations.name: Hollowing Shift
animations.description: Character's veins pulse with dark energy. Appearance subtly changes — more gaunt, darker eyes.

music.name: Ember Vale — Exploration
music.description: Solo cello over distant ambient drones. Occasional dissonant strings. 60 BPM. Weight of a dead world.

music.name: Frostbound Peaks — Summit
music.description: Crystalline bells over howling wind ambience. Choir enters at crescendo. 80 BPM.

music.name: Boss Battle — Warden
music.description: Full orchestral assault. War drums, brass stabs, choir. Dynamic layers that intensify with boss phases.

music.name: The Pale Reach
music.description: Reverse piano, detuned strings, whispered vocals. No discernible rhythm. Wrongness.

sfx.name: Bonfire Rest
sfx.description: Deep bass warmth, crackling fire, a sigh of relief, subtle harmonic chord that resolves tension.

sfx.name: Death
sfx.description: Muffled impact, slow heartbeat fading, silence, then the sound of embers scattering.

sfx.name: Ember Pickup
sfx.description: Soft chime with warm undertone. Like collecting starlight.

sfx.name: Parry
sfx.description: Sharp metallic clang with high-pitched ring. Time seems to stop for a beat.

ambient.name: Ember Vale Night
ambient.description: Distant crackling, wind through hollow ruins, occasional groan of settling earth, ash falling.

ambient.name: Frostbound Wind
ambient.description: Constant howling wind, ice singing at different pitches, distant avalanche rumble.

voice.voice_description: Old, weary, kind. Female voice with warmth beneath exhaustion. Speaks slowly, choosing words carefully.
sample_lines: Rest here, Emberborn. The road ahead is long.
The Crown remembers those who carried it. It does not forgive.

voice.voice_description: Multiple voices layered slightly out of sync. Whisper and boom simultaneously. Male, female, neither.
sample_lines: You are a memory trying to remember itself.
The Crown was never meant to be whole. It was meant to be forgotten.

vfx.name: Ember Trail
vfx.description: Fading orange particles trailing behind weapon swings and character movement.

vfx.name: Rune Resonance
vfx.description: Two elemental colors collide and spiral into a bright burst. Screen flash. Impact shockwave.

vfx.name: Hollowing Aura
vfx.description: Dark energy wisps rising from character. Intensity scales with Hollowing level.

vfx.name: Mythic Drop
vfx.description: Item on ground pulses with golden-orange light. Beam of light shoots upward. Distant choir.

quests.name: The First Ember
quests.description: Awaken at the Ashfield Crossing with no memory. Find the first bonfire. Defeat the Ashen Hollows blocking the path. Receive your first Rune.

steps.description: Find the bonfire at the ruined crossroads.
Defeat the Ashen Hollows on the old road.
Meet the Last Keeper at the bonfire.
Receive the Faded Rune of Fire.

quests.name: The Frozen Warden
quests.description: Seek the second Crown Shard in the Frostbound Peaks. Confront the Frostbound Warden.

steps.description: Solve the Ice Spires light puzzles.

quests.name: The Choice of Crowns
quests.description: The final quest. Confront Vorthak and decide the fate of the Ember Crown — and the world.

steps.description: Choose: Restore the Crown or Destroy it.

items: The Ember Crown (restored) or Memory of the Crown (destroyed)

quests.name: The Last Dragon
quests.description: Find the dragon heart in Dragon's Rest. Decide whether to revive the dragon or harvest its power.

steps.description: Discover Dragon's Rest in the Frostbound Peaks.

world_events.name: Blood Moon
world_events.description: Every 7 in-game days, a blood moon rises. All enemies are stronger, drop more Ember, and unique Blood Moon variants appear.

world_events.name: Warden's Echo
world_events.description: A ghostly echo of a previously defeated Warden appears in a random zone. Defeating it grants bonus Remnants.

world_events.name: The Shifting Maze
world_events.description: Using a Monolith Compass near a Monolith opens a portal to a shifting maze. Completing it grants a Pristine Rune Shard.

ui.style: Dark minimalist with ember accents. Thin borders, clean fonts. HUD elements are semi-transparent dark panels with faint ember glow on important indicators. Minimal screen clutter — only essential info visible during combat.

hud_elements.name: Health Bar
hud_elements.description: Thin horizontal bar. Deep red. Pulses when low. Flask charges shown as small circles below.

hud_elements.name: Stamina Bar
hud_elements.description: Thin bar below health. Yellow-green. Depletes on sprint, attack, dodge.

hud_elements.name: Mana Indicator
hud_elements.description: Small blue orb next to stamina. Glows brighter when full.

hud_elements.name: Rune Display
hud_elements.description: 3 small rune icons showing equipped runes. Active rune glows. Matches element color.

hud_elements.name: Enemy Health
hud_elements.description: Appears on targeting. Name, health bar, and elemental affinity icon.

hud_elements.name: Ember Count
hud_elements.description: Small ember icon with count. Pulses when Ember is gained.

menus.name: Equipment
menus.description: Grid inventory with equipment slots. Character preview with current gear. Rune loadout section.

menus.name: Rune Codex
menus.description: Collection of discovered runes. Shows element, abilities, resonance combos, and upgrade paths.

menus.name: World Map
menus.description: Hand-drawn map that fills as you explore. Bonfires shown as ember icons. Discovered areas in color, undiscovered in sketch.

menus.name: Bestiary
menus.description: Encyclopedia of defeated enemies. Lore, weakness info, kill count, and drops.

menus.name: Settings
menus.description: Graphics, audio, controls. Includes difficulty modifiers and accessibility options.
